map.坑探（穿脉/沿脉/取样）方式 使用指南: Pitting (cross-cut / drift / sampling) Method User Guide
map.坑探（穿脉/沿脉/取样）方式工具。输入坑探参数，给出穿脉、沿脉与取样方式的布置建: Pitting (cross-cut / drift / sampling) method tool. Enter pitting parameters and get layout advice for cross-cuts, drifts and sampling methods, for mineral exploration pitting design and logging reference.
map.穿脉布置：垂直矿体走向掘进穿脉，揭穿矿体全厚，确定厚度与产状: Cross-cut layout: drive cross-cuts perpendicular to the orebody strike to expose the full thickness and determine thickness and attitude
map.沿脉布置：沿矿体走向掘进沿脉，控制走向延伸与品位变化: Drift layout: drive a drift along the orebody strike to control strike extension and grade variation
map.刻槽取样：在坑壁按固定断面刻槽，控制样长获取代表样: Channel sampling: cut a channel on the pit wall at a fixed section, controlling sample length to obtain a representative sample
map.：布置原则：穿脉间距按勘探线距（如 40–80m）布置以控制厚度；沿脉间距按矿体: : layout principles: cross-cut spacing follows the exploration line spacing (for example 40-80 m) to control thickness; drift spacing follows orebody stability (for example 50-100 m); the channel section is commonly 10×5 cm (width × depth) with sample length generally 1-2 m, cut continuously along the hanging wall and footwall (local reference, must comply with pitting codes such as DZ/T 0078).
map.：例：某脉状矿体走向长 200m、厚 3m，按穿脉间距 40m 布置 5 条穿脉: : example: a vein-type orebody with a strike length of 200 m and thickness 3 m; lay out 5 cross-cuts at 40 m spacing to expose thickness, and drifts at 50 m spacing to control extension; channel section 10×5 cm, sample length 2 m, single sample volume about 0.001 m³ (10 cm × 5 cm × 200 cm), representing the average grade of a 2 m orebody segment.
map.穿脉和沿脉怎么区分？: How do cross-cuts and drifts differ?
map.穿脉垂直矿体走向、用于揭穿全厚；沿脉平行矿体走向、用于控制延伸与品位变化。二者配: A cross-cut runs perpendicular to the orebody strike to expose the full thickness; a drift runs parallel to the strike to control extension and grade variation. Using both together gives both thickness and strike variation.
map.刻槽样长为什么控制 1–2m？: Why is channel sample length controlled at 1-2 m?
map.样过长会掩盖矿化不均，过短代表性不足。1–2m 是兼顾代表性与精度的经验值，矿化: Too long a sample masks uneven mineralization and too short is unrepresentative. 1-2 m is the empirical compromise between representativeness and precision; with extremely uneven mineralization shorten to 0.5-1 m and sample more densely.
